verdict.rationale: Abacum's own marketing describes a built-in 'AI Modeler' that builds financial models from plain-language requests. It also says AI runs inside the model to answer questions, which is a built-in assistant users can hand modeling and Q&A tasks to. The evidence is only brief marketing claims, with no detail on what tasks can be delegated or how far it acts on its own. Missing for 10: documentation of delegable task scope and agent actions beyond model-building and answering questions, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the assistant works as claimed.
